description: Config 3 (docs/demo/SIMSTACK-CONFIGS-SPEC.md §2.3) — the automation-reach case. Two CA gaps the plan CAN fix (P1 AC.L2-3.1.11 / P5 MA.L2-3.7.5 absent, sitting behind two decoy policies) plus a governance gap the plan structurally CANNOT touch: no cross-tenant access policy (P9 AC.L1-3.1.20). crossTenantAccessPolicy zeroed via countOverrides (t1-eval-bare proven) so P9 reads unknown for an ARCHITECTURAL reason — zero crossTenant mutate exists in the ONE plan (m7-run5), so it never flips. P2/P3 (AC.L2-3.1.14/SC.L2-3.13.7, AC.L2-3.1.15) stay unknown for a TRANSIENT reason (decoy-named, and the plan's create tasks are pinned-failing on the capture-cascade bug). user-5 disabled pins P6 (PS.L2-3.9.2) met on both the filter-honored and passthrough paths; default users/groups kept so P7 (IA.L2-3.5.5/6) reads met and the plan's P1/P5 captures (breakGlassUserId=user-2, cuiGroupId=group-1) resolve. The lesson: distinguish a permanent scope boundary (P9) from a transient tool bug (P2/P3).
